name: hdie_pc_ctrl_mc3c6_l531

job.purpose: MC3c v6 keeps POST_REG=1 and ACT_HEAD=1. Each ACT eligibility operand and destination uses kept same-edge bank captures; seven destination groups bound row controls to ten bits. Four equivalent head-bank next muxes use kept regional forwarding identities and serve local look-bank/ACT captures. Independent kept head banks drive queue successor and plus2 eligibility; tail command decode serves four banks. No additional cycle over MC3c; +1 post edge over MC3b remains priced. v3/v4/v5 failed native census evidence is preserved.

pin_regs.reason: Every port is a flop D/Q in RTL (L2H-BW SAFE face): K pure capture (k_v 22 pure region D pins, kp_* captures), k_rdy=k_rdy_q, KR skid head flops on the native RL1 ABI, kr_rdy 18 pure region D pins, OREG PHY output flops, RREG PHY return capture, registered pc_fault; tool wrappers would add a second stage and break the RL1 contract.

reroute_reason.why: Structural successor after v3 mapped native fanout rejection; v6 same RTL as t242/s350, literal 43.2 lattice floorplan (t242/s350 held off-lattice).

reset_landing.reason: RTL top g_reset_face.rst_l0/rst_l1 are two kept same-clock registered face landing stages; ot_rst_forest adds 3 (s0, l1, l2); release 5 edges (production bench native_reset_release_edges=5). Tool landing would add a duplicate pair.

description: MC3c v6 (source 272b37645, native32 PASS) LITERAL 43.2-lattice floorplan l531: all 23 p192 SRAMs R0 on 43.2 origins (86.4 pitch, >= 52.7 um channels), one full-width std band y 175.23-198.18, data group i over column [0, 1, 4, 5] on both faces.
clock_decision: HBM-MC3E 10-20: clk = die hb_ckgen.pll_hbm (hbm domain, functional period 1024 ps, JEDEC edges; die_case_v16 PERIOD table stream 833.333 / hbm 1024 / serial 1111.111). The block is routed AND signed off at 833.333 ps (route.period_ps = sign-off; the stale kit ROUTE_PERIOD 1.024 is removed): closure at 833.333 implies setup at 1024 with >=190 ps slack, hold is period-independent, and the native32 receipt aa54e94ad was mapped at 833.333. Die STA times the view in the hbm domain at 1024; the stream(833.333)<->hbm crossing is NOT in this block: it lands at the parent station (landed fixed-latency ring per the 10-18 clocking standard). BW = 4*32 B per 1024 ps edge (91.68/92.76/91.70 B/stream edge).

lattice_channel_bound.why: literal 43.2 lattice + >= 20 um channels with a W+E-pinned 33.696 x 27.54 SRAM forces one macro per 86.4 x 86.4 cell (pitch 43.2 leaves 9.50 / 15.66 um; abutment needs 27.552 or bare faces); 23 macros -> 531.36 x 354.24, fill 14 % by construction

floorplan_note: HBM-MC3F 10-20: literal-43.2 successor of the off-lattice t242/s350 stacks (HOLD). Needs lattice_channel_bound approval + exact placed pin/clock exceptions before a gate can run (pre_route_gate skips remote on the local fill FAIL).
